coincident_multicategory.expectation: Common support with different overlapping three-category emissions.

coincident_null.expectation: Common support and identical stochastic terminal laws expose plug-in TV bias.

constant_cell.expectation: A constant start abstraction still aliases responses with a fixed external outcome.

constant_response.expectation: Replacing the external outcome with a constant makes distances vanish.

four_state.expectation: The intervention shrinks equilibrium support but the passive starts still disagree.

impossible.expectation: An unreachably labelled state aliases with the start cell but is inadmissible.

multi_step_exit.expectation: The first transition enters a zero-mass bridge and the second uses it.

persistent.expectation: Repeating the first operator instead leads both starts to the same outcome.

post_only.expectation: A zero-passive-mass terminal state supplies an admissible intervention outcome.

rare.expectation: A positive state of mass 1e-8 controls the full diameter.

ring_asym.expectation: Velocity is known and two passive-compatible contexts disagree after the probe.

ring_l1.expectation: Opposite velocities from one position produce different next positions.

ring_l2.expectation: Two passive positions determine velocity and each start cell is a singleton.

scope: Known finite synthetic fixtures and declared passive starts
